    }     ffmpeg -i "Your Name.mp4" -ss 00:00:21 -to 01:35:10 -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 18 -c:a aac -b:a 192k "Your Name-Trimmed.mp4"

6.0 -   upscale quality of Video
